plugins.name: Pure Control
plugins.blurb: LLM assistant that drives Ableton Live by chat.

detail.tagline: An AI assistant that lives inside Ableton Live — tell it what you want, and it drives your session.
detail.description: Pure Control puts a producer-grade AI assistant directly in your Ableton Live session. Type what you want — "build me a techno session at 128", "sidechain the bass to the kick", "warm up the master" — and it performs the moves on real devices through a native Live bridge: loading instruments, shaping sounds, building full arrangements. It runs on your Pure BPM Coinz balance, so there are no API keys to manage.
highlights: One-prompt session builder — drums, bass, lead hooks and arrangement, varied every time
Mix & mastering moves applied to your actual set — curated device chains, gain staging, sidechain
Chat mode for production questions, Work mode for hands-on control
requirements: Installs the Live remote script for you

plugins.name: Pure AI
plugins.blurb: Generate tracks and split stems, right inside Ableton.

detail.tagline: Generate full tracks and split any take into stems — without leaving Ableton.
detail.description: Pure AI is a music generator and stem-separation suite inside your DAW. Prompt a full track — genre, mood, BPM — and audition takes right in the plugin; then split any take (or any audio file you load) into stems: vocals, drums, bass, and more, with guitar and piano in beta. Masters and stems land in your local Pure BPM library on your machine, drag-ready for any track. Generation and separation run on your Coinz balance.
highlights: Full-track generation with style, mood and BPM control — multiple takes per prompt
Stem separation on generated takes or your own audio files — 4 stems, plus guitar & piano (beta)
Everything stored locally in your Pure BPM library — drag straight into your session

plugins.name: Pure Samples
plugins.blurb: Generate drag-ready samples from a text prompt.

detail.tagline: Type a sound, get a sample — hi-fi one-shots and loops generated from text.
detail.description: Pure Samples is a text-to-sample generator that lives in your DAW. Describe the sound — "dusty vinyl kick", "metallic riser, 4 bars", "wet clap with tape saturation" — and it renders a high-fidelity, drag-ready sample. Every take lands in your sample tray: audition, re-roll, set length and looping, then drag it onto a track. Your tray restores with the plugin, and samples are stored locally — they're yours. Generations run on your Coinz balance.
highlights: Hi-fi 44.1 kHz stereo output — drum hits, FX, textures, risers
Length & loop controls, with a sample tray that restores between sessions
Drag straight to any Ableton track — samples stored locally, yours to keep
